description:
Use this when the user wants to put one clip on their posting calendar: "schedule this clip for Friday",
        "post this to TikTok tonight", "put it on Shorts and Reels". RipClip saves a DRAFT; to post it, show the
        user the draft and, once they say yes, update_draft with schedule=true. platform: tiktok, youtube, instagram, facebook, threads or bluesky ("Shorts", "Reels",
        "IG" also work; X is coming soon). clip_id: from list_clips. caption: the post text, up to 2,200 characters. scheduled_at (optional): ISO 8601
        with its offset, e.g. 2026-10-24T18:00:00-05:00. account_id (optional): from list_social_accounts. One call
        per platform. Returns review_url: tell the user to open it, check the draft and schedule it in RipClip.
        Not for: writing caption options first (write_captions), drafting a whole week in one call (plan_posts),
        changing an existing draft (update_draft), or publishing right now (no tool here publishes). Free.
name: draft_post
title: Draft a post
